title: Chapter 156: Powerful Special Forces
content:
Chapter 156: Powerful Special Forces

Under Wu Qing's command, the flying dragon in the air launched an attack on a forest on the ground.

The flying dragon sprayed a mass of matter at the target location!

The dragon in the magic world sprays dragon breath, while the Zerg flying dragon sprays a shell composed of micro-organisms wrapped in Zerg biological decomposition fluid!

When this shell hits the target, it explodes violently, causing great damage to the target!

The micro-organisms in some shells will fly around along the shock wave of the explosion. They are themselves micro-biological bombs, which will cause secondary explosions and cause damage to other targets near the target.

The attack ability of the flying dragon is quite considerable. Except that its armor-piercing ability is not as good as that of the hydralisk, it is stronger than the hydralisk in other aspects.

The flying dragon has a very strong flying ability. It inherits some characteristics of the game settings. It can fly in the air for a long time and can also hover. In addition, its flying speed is extremely fast and its flying movements are flexible. It can be said to be an expert in flying in the air!

Wu Qing is very satisfied with the performance of the flying dragon. As long as their star rating is improved, they will definitely become the overlord of the air!

After the air force tower is built, the Zerg's other flying unit, the explosive mosquito, can also be hatched.

The explosive mosquito, as its name suggests, is a Zerg flying unit that can explode.

Wu Qing consumes 25 energy and 75 gas resources, selects a larva, and chooses to hatch the explosive mosquito.

Two Zergs smaller than the Zerg puppies broke out of the pupa. The explosive mosquitoes, like the Zerg puppies, are hatched in pairs, and the resource consumption of one explosive mosquito is reduced by half.

They are like fat mosquitoes with periosteal wings, with thin limbs to support them to stay on the ground.

Wu Qing observed the appearance and structure of the explosive mosquitoes, and let them fly up and circle around the Zerg territory.

Their normal flying speed is slightly slower than that of the dragon, but their unique body structure allows them to have the ability to burst accelerate over short distances, and the flying speed in the accelerated state is twice as fast as that of the dragon!

This sudden acceleration ability allows the explosive mosquito to successfully rush to the target and launch a suicide bombing attack.

Wu Qing ordered an explosive mosquito to suddenly accelerate and crash into the ground!

"Boom!" With a loud bang, the explosive mosquito exploded, and the power of the explosion was comparable to the explosive attack launched by dozens of flying dragons at the same time!

The explosive mosquito has a strong explosive power, but its disadvantage is that it consumes a lot of gas resources, and it is a one-time soldier, which will be gone after one explosion.

Its advantage is that the lethality released instantly is very strong, and it is very effective against enemy soldiers with strong defense capabilities and limited effects of ordinary attacks on them.

If this explosive mosquito was born earlier, the queen might not have to attack twice on the battlefield.

...

After the queen's nest was built, Wu Qing selected a larva and could choose to hatch the queen, a special Zerg soldier.

If flying dragons and explosive mosquitoes are the regular soldiers of the Zerg, then the queen is the special soldier of the Zerg.

Wu Qing was about to choose to hatch the queen, but suddenly saw the long string of numbers on the resources that needed to be consumed, and stopped immediately!

Wu Qing counted carefully, and the resources consumed reached five digits!

And the gas resources consumed were more than the energy resources!

Hatching a queen consumes tens of thousands of resources. This is the first time Wu Qing has encountered such a situation. He calmed down and carefully checked the system instructions.

It turned out that the queen's initial strength star is three stars, and the Zerg cannot hatch queens below three stars.

This is the first Zerg soldier with an initial strength requirement, which shows its extraordinaryness.

Wu Qing now understands that every setting of the system is for a reason. The minimum strength requirement for the queen is three stars, which means that queens below three stars cannot exert the queen's ability and have no need to exist.

Hatching a three-star queen consumes a lot of energy and qi, and qi can just hatch 600 hydralisks!

Fortunately, the previous battle made the system's resources very sufficient, so there is no need to worry about the consumption of these qi resources.

The same procedure is repeated, consuming resources, the larvae pupate, and the queen breaks out of the pupa. The first three-star soldier of the Zerg is born!

The three-star queen is a circle larger than the flying dragon just now. Its appearance is a strange big insect with a huge periosteum.

The appearance is hideous and horrible, which is not in line with the beautiful name of Queen!

The periosteum on the Queen does not seem to conform to the principles of aerodynamics. Their flying principle should be similar to that of the host, not relying on wings.

Among the three flying soldiers that the Zerg has just unlocked, except for the periosteum of the dragon, which is somewhat like normal wings, the periosteum of the explosive mosquito and the queen does not look like normal wings.

Wu Qing feels that the flying principles of the Zerg flying soldiers, including the dragon, are not normal aerodynamic principles. The Zerg is a cosmic race, and there is no air in many environments.

Therefore, Wu Qing will not find it strange that the Zerg flying soldiers grow into strange shapes.

The first time Wu Qing faced the three-star soldiers of the Zerg at close range, he could feel the powerful mental power of the Queen and the huge energy stored in her body.

Hatching the Queen consumes Qi, which is equivalent to a point of luck, which makes it directly have powerful strength, not including its powerful special abilities.

This chapter is not over, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The Queen in the initial state has only one special ability, that is, parasitic control, which is a powerful ability derived from system optimization and transformation!

The queen uses the parasitic control ability to release a special parasite that enters the body of a creature and forcibly parasitizes and controls the creature!

This is an enhanced version of the Zerg parasite that Wu Qing and the queen hatched through the larvae. Zerg parasites can only parasitize and control creatures that have lost their ability to resist, while the parasites released by the queen can be used directly on creatures in any state.

On the battlefield, the queen releases parasites to forcibly control the enemy's soldiers and use them for our own purposes!

The strength of this forced control ability is related to the strength of both the queen and the enemy. The stronger the queen's strength, the stronger the parasite's forced control ability.

The stronger the enemy's strength, the weaker the parasite's forced control ability.

If a queen with three-star strength controls ordinary soldiers, one parasite can control one soldier, and one release can control a large group!

If she wants to control an enemy with the same three-star strength or above, the queen must go all out and use all her parasites to forcibly control an enemy, constantly consuming until the parasitic control succeeds or fails.

Facing a powerful enemy, the queen's parasitic control has a chance of failure.

However, it has a chance to successfully force control of an enemy that is stronger than itself, which is already a very scary ability!

In the future, the Great Xia Territory will not only have Zerg parasites transformed from ordinary evil god believers, but also Zerg parasite armies transformed from evil god believers' soldiers!

In addition to the inherent ability of parasitic control, the queen has three abilities that can only be obtained through the upgrade options of the queen's nest.

These three abilities are parasitic reconnaissance, trapping and spawning.

Parasitic reconnaissance is somewhat similar to parasitic control. It also releases a special parasite that parasitizes the enemy. The Zerg can collect all the information around the enemy through parasitic reconnaissance.

The characteristics of this parasite are that it is invisible and traceless, almost imperceptible, and cannot be removed!

For creatures parasitized and controlled by Zerg parasites, people with strong enough strength and keen enough perception may still be able to detect the existence of Zerg parasites.

However, the special parasites released by parasitic reconnaissance have different parasitic methods and mission purposes, which will be difficult to detect, let alone be easily eliminated!

If the Queen's ability is used well, it can play a very strong role!

Trapping is to give the Queen the ability to capture prey and enemies, allowing it to spray a giant net composed of viscous green liquid. The prey and enemies caught in the giant net will be greatly restricted in their ability to move!

When the two armies are fighting, this ability is a sure-win skill if used well!

It has a good effect of unexpectedly dealing with charging enemies, fleeing enemies, and capturing important enemies!

The Queen's last ability, spawning, is its only skill that can directly kill the enemy!

The Queen can launch a string of spores at a non-machine life form at a very long distance. These spores are pervasive and can ignore powerful defenses and invade the target's body!

In the game setting, even the powerful energy shield of the Protoss cannot prevent the invasion of such spores!

The spores absorb energy and nutrients in the target's body at a very fast speed, and can grow into an explosive parasite within a few seconds, and explode immediately, killing the target from the target's body!

The Queen's ability is very terrible! Theoretically, no creature can defend against this kind of attack!

But this world is mysterious and unpredictable, and the Queen's ability should also be subject to some limitations of strength. There is no invincible ability in this world!

...

After Wu Qing fully understood the Queen's ability, he realized the horror of the special Zerg army. If he wanted to use such means, he would definitely not be able to do it without strong strength.

Parasitic control, parasitic reconnaissance, trapping and spawning are four powerful abilities, each of which can play a huge role!

The Queen, who combines four abilities in one, is a well-deserved "Queen" in terms of ability!

Wu Qing finally tested the Queen's flying speed, and its flying speed is much faster than that of the flying dragon!

It may not be as fast as the three-star flying dragon, but the Queen's current speed is enough to ensure its safety when performing tasks alone.

It flies in the air at a high speed and has a long attack range, so it is very difficult to harm it.
